news.title: Burnham wants one million more girls in sport by 2035 Women’s World Cup in UK
news.lede: Andy Burnham has set out a target to inspire one million additional girls to participate in sport ahead of the UK hosting the 2035 Women’s World Cup . As part of the initiative, the Government stated that sporting organisations will only receive public money if they can prove "structural equality". According to officials, the ambition will examine female representation across viewing statistics, coaching roles and boardrooms, while working to guarantee girls equal access at school to sports such as football and rugby.Addressing a Downing Street reception celebrating women’s sport on Monday evening, the Prime Minister expressed his wish for the period leading up to 2035 to be "game-changing for girls up and down the country".

news.title: Ghana win the amputee World Cup, two days after sorting out their players' bonuses
news.lede: Ghana’s amputee football team won the World Cup in Mexico on Sunday, two days after a mining company, the national football association and the Paralympic committee agreed to cover bonuses and daily allowances the players were still owed when they reached the semifinals, according to Ghanaian broadcaster 3News. Under that Nov. 20 agreement, Gold Fields Ghana would bring forward part of its 2027 sponsorship, drawn from a two-year, $5 million deal signed with the Ghana Football Association in May. The money would pay each player and delegation member $8,000 if Ghana reached the final, a figure for approved allowances and bonuses rather than prize money, the National Paralympic Committee of Ghana said, according to 3News and MyJoyOnline.

news.title: Hosting World Cup means decade of excitement - Weir
news.lede: Caroline Weir says it is "amazing" that Scotland will host the World Cup finals. Scotland captain Caroline Weir says hosting the 2035 Women's World Cup along with England, Northern Ireland and Wales will usher in "an amazing decade of excitement" for the game in her homeland. World governing body Fifa confirmed on Monday that the United Kingdom will host a football World Cup for the first time since England won the men's tournament on home soil in 1966. Scotland's national stadium at Hampden Park in Glasgow and Hibernian's Easter Road Stadium in Leith are among 19 venues chosen for the 39-day competition involving 48 teams.

news.title: FIFA Names USA, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica Hosts of 2031 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: The United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will jointly host the 2031 FIFA Women’s World Cup, while the United Kingdom’s four football associations have been selected to stage the 2035 edition. FIFA has officially appointed the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica as co-hosts of the 2031 FIFA Women’s World Cup, which will make history as the first edition of the tournament to feature 48 participating teams. The announcement was made during FIFA’s Extraordinary Congress held virtually, where member associations approved the host nations by acclamation following comprehensive bidding processes. The 2031 tournament will also mark the first time the FIFA Women’s World Cup is staged across four different member associations, representing a significant milestone in the global development of women’s football.

news.title: FIFA Women’s World Cup expands to 48 teams as future hosts confirmed
news.lede: FIFA have confirmed the hosts of the 2031 and 2035 Women’s World Cups, with both tournaments set to feature 48 teams for the first time. The United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will jointly stage the 2031 tournament, while England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland will host the 2035 edition. The decisions were approved by acclamation at an Extraordinary FIFA Congress, held virtually on Tuesday November 24, 2026 (NZT). Both bids were unopposed, following bidding processes FIFA launched in March 2025.

news.title: Mohammed Mubarik Wins Golden Boot as Ghana’s Black Challenge Star Caps Historic World Cup Campaign
news.lede: Ghanaian forward Mohammed Mubarik has been crowned the Golden Boot winner at the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup after finishing as the tournament’s leading goalscorer with seven goals. Mubarik played a pivotal role in Ghana’s historic triumph in Mexico, where the Black Challenge defeated Morocco 1-0 in the final to lift their first-ever Amputee Football World Cup trophy. The prolific forward enjoyed an outstanding campaign in front of goal, consistently delivering for Ghana and finishing ahead of his competitors to claim the tournament’s top individual scoring award. His achievement further underlines his growing reputation as one of the leading figures in amputee football, having also enjoyed an impressive run at continental level.

news.title: USA, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica to host 2031 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: The United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica have been appointed as hosts of the 2031 FIFA Women’s World Cup. The decision was confirmed at a virtual Extraordinary FIFA Congress, with the four nations appointed by acclamation following a bidding process launched by the FIFA Council in March 2025. The 2031 tournament will be a landmark occasion for the women’s game, becoming the first Women’s World Cup to feature 48 teams and the first to be hosted across four member associations.FIFA President Gianni Infantino described the decision as an important moment in the organisation’s ambition to make women’s football a truly global game.“.
